fields.name: Circuit breaker
fields.definition: The fail-fast stage of the resilience strategy. After `CircuitBreakerFailureCount` consecutive failures on a data connection, further calls on that connection fail immediately instead of queuing behind a database that is unlikely to answer. After `CircuitBreakerTestInterval` milliseconds a single trial call is allowed through; if it succeeds, normal traffic resumes. Each read or write endpoint has its own breaker. Configuring a failure count below 1 disables it.
